title: WRT invariants as radial homological-block limits for negative-definite unimodular six-vertex H-plumbings with leaf weights at most minus two
author: Akihito Mori; Yuya Murakami
source_title: Witten-Reshetikhin-Turaev Invariants, Homological Blocks, and Quantum Modular Forms for Unimodular Plumbing H-Graphs
difficulty_reason: The proof resolves incomplete surgery Gauss sums by deriving weighted cancellations for the two-variable plumbing quadratic form. It matches a two-variable Euler-Maclaurin radial expansion to finite Bernoulli-weighted sums, then explicitly transforms the Kirby-color surgery expression through reciprocity. The new vanishing identities supply precisely the missing lattice terms, making the radial-limit formula rigorous beyond formal q-series or cited Seifert formulas.
source_version: Official SIGMA 18 (2022) article 034, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2022.034; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: The complete author Theorem1.1 route is supplied: weighted Gauss Proposition4.2 with all local arithmetic proofs, Euler-Maclaurin Lemma5.2/Proposition5.3, the surgery formula6.1 and completion identities6.2–6.5. Select the negative-definite determinant-one six-vertex H linking matrix with all weights negative and leaf weights w3–w6<=-2, at integer levels k>=3 so the displayed normalization denominator is nonzero. These explicit restrictions exclude the separately known Seifert/degenerate-normalization edge cases. The exact principal-value homological block and standard S3-normalized WRT convention are retained. Existing surgery formula(6.1), Gauss reciprocity and two-variable Euler-Maclaurin are background; the author proves the new weighted cancellations and lattice completion. The general standalone auxiliary statements4.2/4.4 are not counted; their actual application is only on the nonzero support of the plumbing weight epsilon. Later quantum modularity is a consequence of a prior theorem and is not selected.

statement_scope: Theorem1.1 identity(1.2) with explicit non-Seifert leaf weights w3,w4,w5,w6<=-2 and k>=3; no separate auxiliary Gauss claims or quantum-modularity conclusion.
editorial_warning: Auxiliary Lemma4.4 prints arbitrary gamma in Q^2, while its displayed proof uses the primitive denominators of Assumption4.1(ii). In the selected weighted plumbing application, only epsilon(gamma)!=0 contributes. Preserve the original auxiliary statement and its full proof; do not broaden it into a separately counted universal claim.
